datasets.title: LUISA - Land Use-based Integrated Sustainability Assessment Base Map 2018
datasets.description: High-resolution land use/land cover map from LUISA modelling platform
datasets.purpose: To provide high-resolution land use and land cover mapping across Europe with finer spatial and thematic detail for land accounting, modeling, and spatial planning applications.

project.name: LUISA : Land-Use based Integrated Sustainability Assessment modelling platform

datasets.details: LUISA Base Map delivers higher spatial detail and finer thematic breakdown of land use/cover categories (17 categories) compared to CORINE (11 categories), covering EU27 and additional European countries including Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Iceland, Kosovo, Liechtenstein, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Norway, Serbia, Switzerland, Turkey, and United Kingdom. The map has a minimum mapping unit (MMU) of 1 hectare for artificial surfaces and 5 hectares for non-artificial surfaces, with pixel resolution of 50-100m. The 2018 edition refines CORINE Land Cover 2018 through automated geospatial data fusion, integrating information from Copernicus High Resolution Layers, Urban Atlas, Global Human Settlement Layer, CLC Change Maps, and other trusted datasets. This uniform methodology using European-wide remotely sensed imagery ensures high comparability across countries, making it suitable for applications requiring fine spatial and thematic detail of land use/cover consistently across Europe.

sources.name: European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC)
sources.description: LUISA Base Map 2018 - a high-resolution land use and land cover map produced by the European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) using a structured, automated geospatial data fusion approach. Integrates Copernicus High Resolution Layers, Urban Atlas, Coastal Zones dataset, Global Human Settlement Layer, TomTom Multinet, and OpenStreetMap onto a CORINE 2018 base. Provides 17 thematic categories at 1 ha minimum mapping unit for artificial surfaces and 5 ha for non-artificial surfaces. Covers EU-27 plus wider European area.

resources.title: LUISA Basemap 50m spatial resolution
resources.description: Higher-detail LUISA basemap providing harmonized land-use/land-cover and cartographic context. Cell size: 50 m; suited for local to regional analyses and map production.

resources.title: LUISA Basemap 100m spatial resolution
resources.description: Raster basemap from the LUISA framework showing harmonized land-use/land-cover and ancillary context for European territories. Cell size: 100 m; intended for visualization and overlay with hazard/exposure layers.

resources.title: ArcGIS Layer Style
resources.description: Preconfigured ArcGIS (.lyr/.lyrx) symbology and render settings to display this dataset consistently (color ramps, classification, labels). Import into ArcGIS Pro/ArcMap to apply styles in one step.

resources.title: QGIS Layer Style
resources.description: QGIS (.qml) style file with predefined symbology, classification, and labeling for consistent visualization. Load in QGIS via Layer Properties → Style to apply immediately.

resources.title: Legend description
resources.description: Human-readable legend explaining classes, colors, and units used by the basemap/styles, including notes on classification rules and any special symbols in spreadsheet.
